detailed_descriptions.en: This pack unlocks over 50 new Homestead Furniture items and variants to craft, including: New Variants of Existing Benches and Furniture Expand your base with functional homestead variants including the Brick Fireplace, Electric Fridge, Water Tank, Silo, Kitchen Bench / Stove / Sink & Storage (T3), Iron Stove (Potbelly Alternative), Spinning Wheel, Well (Rain Reservoir), plus additional cabinet, seating and bed options. These function the same as the items they're based on, with a classic aesthetic. Interior Decorations Add handcrafted homestead detail throughout your interior spaces with food displays, soft furnishings and rustic feature pieces. Includes Butter Churns, Coffee Grinder, preserves and pantry décor, cushions, knitting pieces, Cuckoo Clock, and Fireplace accessories. Exterior Decorations Complete the homestead look outside with Iron and Gold Birdbaths and a working Weather Vane. New Light Options Expand your lighting options with fat-powered Lamp Posts (Floor & Wall), Wall Candles and the deployable Homestead Lantern. Farming & Utility Objects Support your claim with Planter Boxes (Crop Plot), Scarecrow (Spawn Blocker) and the multi-use Pitchfork (Spear with Sickle functionalities). Building Pieces Add homestead-specific build options including Shutters (2 variations), Curtains (6 variations) and Saloon Doors (2 variations).

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This pack unlocks over 50 new Homestead Furniture items and variants to craft, including:

  • New Variants of Existing Benches and Furniture
    Expand your base with functional homestead variants including the Brick Fireplace, Electric Fridge, Water Tank, Silo, Kitchen Bench / Stove / Sink & Storage (T3), Iron Stove (Potbelly Alternative), Spinning Wheel, Well (Rain Reservoir), plus additional cabinet, seating and bed options. These function the same as the items they're based on, with a classic aesthetic.

  • Interior Decorations
    Add handcrafted homestead detail throughout your interior spaces with food displays, soft furnishings and rustic feature pieces. Includes Butter Churns, Coffee Grinder, preserves and pantry décor, cushions, knitting pieces, Cuckoo Clock, and Fireplace accessories.

  • Exterior Decorations
    Complete the homestead look outside with Iron and Gold Birdbaths and a working Weather Vane.

  • New Light Options
    Expand your lighting options with fat-powered Lamp Posts (Floor & Wall), Wall Candles and the deployable Homestead Lantern.

  • Farming & Utility Objects
    Support your claim with Planter Boxes (Crop Plot), Scarecrow (Spawn Blocker) and the multi-use Pitchfork (Spear with Sickle functionalities).

  • Building Pieces
    Add homestead-specific build options including Shutters (2 variations), Curtains (6 variations) and Saloon Doors (2 variations).
